title: OpenMed portable SDK configuration
description: Version 1 of the configuration subset that Python and every OpenMedKit port read with the same names, types, bounds and defaults. Unknown keys fail closed. docs/configuration/sdk-config.md maps each key to OpenMedConfig and to the Swift, Kotlin and TypeScript spellings; tests/fixtures/parity/sdk_config_v1.json holds the shared vectors.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum detection confidence. Python takes it per call (extract_pii confidence_threshold); it is not an OpenMedConfig field.

local_only.description: Cache-only, no-egress mode. Maps to OpenMedConfig.local_only; the portable default is true.

model_id.description: Hub repository id of the model. Maps to OpenMedConfig.pii_model; null selects the kit default.

model_revision.description: Pinned revision of model_id. Maps to OpenMedConfig.pii_model_revision. Requires a non-null model_id.

onnx_variant.description: ONNX weight variant. Maps to OpenMedConfig.onnx_variant; runtimes that do not load ONNX ignore it.

policy_profile.description: Portable policy profile name. Python takes it per call (deidentify policy); it is not an OpenMedConfig field.
